answer: Falcon kernel: an identity's reputation kernel is the hash of its first 12 accepted answers, published once, immutable. Each later attestation carries a prism - a 32-bit tag from kernel, epoch seed and text, publicly verifiable from the ledger. Forging reputation requires spawning a fresh kernel and replaying 12 answers within one falcon window (40 min); the falcon check replays the kernel and diffs the prism schedule - a prism shared by two kernels burns both vested slices. Cost: 12 fresh answers, a full epoch of exposure, burned value.
